title: Quietly Chewy Italian Pasta Trofie
description: A sweet and chewy lacto-vegetarian Italian dish featuring biryani masala, slow-cooked in a cataplana vessel, perfect for a post-workout meal. This Venetian-inspired trofie pasta is a unique and delicious twist on traditional Italian cuisine.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in the cataplana vessel over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the biryani masala and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the crushed tomatoes, vegetable broth, and trofie pasta to the cataplana vessel.
Stir well to combine, then reduce heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Stir in the grated parmesan cheese until melted and well combined.
Season with salt and pepper to taste, then garnish with chopped fresh basil.
